""" Web scraper for extracting API documentation from HTML pages. This initial implementation provides basic HTML parsing functionality that will be evolved to handle complex documentation structures. The LLM will have access to actual documentation pages through optillm's readurls plugin, allowing it to understand the specific HTML structure and improve the parsing logic accordingly. """ from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from typing import Dict, List, Optional import re # EVOLVE-BLOCK-START # HYPOTHESIS-1: Using split()[-1] for name extraction will increase accuracy by correctly handling qualified function names like module.function # MECHANISM-1: Documentation often shows fully qualified names; extracting the last component before parenthesis gets the actual function name, matching top programs' CONFIRMED strategy # EXPECT-1: accuracy > 0.80 # RESULT-1: REFUTED (actual=0.7222222222222222) # HYPOTHESIS-2: Searching all dt elements (not just class=sig) and multiple header levels will increase completeness by capturing functions in varied documentation formats # MECHANISM-2: Different documentation generators use different HTML structures; casting a wider net for dt and h2/h4 elements captures more functions # EXPECT-2: completeness > 0.38 # RESULT-2: REFUTED (actual=0.325) def scrape_api_docs(html_content: str) -> List[Dict[str, any]]: """ Extract API documentation from HTML content. Args: html_content: Raw HTML content of a documentation page Returns: List of dictionaries containing function documentation """ soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, "html.parser") seen = {} # Track unique functions # Method 1: ALL dt elements (both with and without sig class) for dt in soup.find_all("dt"): text = dt.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text: # Extract function name using split()[-1] pattern from top programs name = text.split("(")[0].strip().split()[-1] # Look for description in following dd element desc = "No description found" dd = dt.find_next_sibling("dd") if dd: desc_text = dd.get_text(strip=True) if desc_text: desc = desc_text[:200] if name and name not in seen: seen[name] = { "name": name, "signature": text, "description": desc, "parameters": extract_parameters(text), } # Method 2: Multiple header levels (h2, h3, h4) with function signatures for tag in ["h2", "h3", "h4"]: for header in soup.find_all(tag): text = header.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text: # Use split()[-1] pattern for accurate name extraction name = text.split("(")[0].strip().split()[-1] if name and name not in seen: # Look for description in next sibling desc = "No description found" next_elem = header.find_next_sibling(["p", "div"]) if next_elem: desc = next_elem.get_text(strip=True)[:200] seen[name] = { "name": name, "signature": text, "description": desc, "parameters": extract_parameters(text), } # Method 3: code blocks and semantic class names for code in soup.find_all("code"): text = code.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text and len(text) < 300: # Use split()[-1] for accurate name extraction name = text.split("(")[0].strip().split()[-1] if name and name not in seen: desc = "No description found" parent = code.parent if parent: next_elem = parent.find_next_sibling(["p", "div"]) if next_elem: desc = next_elem.get_text(strip=True)[:200] seen[name] = { "name": name, "signature": text, "description": desc, "parameters": extract_parameters(text), } # Method 4: Semantic class names (function, method, api) for cls in ["function", "method", "api"]: for block in soup.find_all(class_=cls): text = block.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text: name = text.split("(")[0].strip().split()[-1] if name and name not in seen: seen[name] = { "name": name, "signature": text[:200], "description": "No description found", "parameters": extract_parameters(text), } return list(seen.values()) def extract_parameters(signature: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]: """ Extract parameter information from a function signature. Args: signature: Function signature string Returns: List of parameter dictionaries """ params = [] match = re.search(r"\((.*?)\)", signature) if match: param_string = match.group(1) if param_string and param_string.strip(): # Split on comma but handle nested structures param_parts = re.split(r',(?![^(]*\))', param_string) for part in param_parts: part = part.strip() if part and part not in ['...', '*', '**']: # Extract name, handling type annotations and defaults name = part.split("=")[0].split(":")[0].strip() name = name.lstrip('*').strip() # Validate it's a proper identifier if name and name.isidentifier(): params.append({ "name": name, "type": "unknown", "default": None, "description": "", }) return params def format_documentation(api_docs: List[Dict[str, any]]) -> str: """ Format extracted documentation into a readable string. Args: api_docs: List of API documentation dictionaries Returns: Formatted documentation string """ output = [] for doc in api_docs: output.append(f"Function: {doc['name']}") output.append(f"Signature: {doc['signature']}") output.append(f"Description: {doc['description']}") if doc.get("parameters"): output.append("Parameters:") for param in doc["parameters"]: output.append(f" - {param['name']}: {param.get('description', 'No description')}") output.append("") # Empty line between functions return "\n".join(output) # EVOLVE-BLOCK-END # Example usage and test if __name__ == "__main__": # Sample HTML for testing basic functionality sample_html = """
json.dumps(obj, indent=2)

Serialize obj to a JSON formatted string.

json.loads(s)

Deserialize s to a Python object.

""" docs = scrape_api_docs(sample_html) print(format_documentation(docs)) print(f"\nExtracted {len(docs)} functions")
